title: Read before you run
points: It writes confident commands, right or wrong.
Anything that deletes, disables, or sends gets read first.

title: Confidence is not evidence
statement: It is confident whether it is right or wrong. Confidence is not evidence.

title: Code review: read it before it runs
source: Examples.md, Review a script before you run it as admin

blocks.text: Read deploy.ps1. I am about to run this as a domain admin. Walk me through what it actually does. Flag anything that reaches out, changes permissions, or hides its activity. … (full prompt: workbook)

Read deploy.ps1. I am about to run this as a domain admin. Walk me through what it actually does, line by line at a high level. Flag anything that reaches out to the internet, changes permissions, touches the registry, deletes files, or hides its own activity. Tell me the three things most likely to cause damage if I run it as-is, and what I should verify before running it.
